# Wildermarch Quest

> A D&D West Marches campaign wiki tracking the collaborative adventures of multiple players exploring the Wildermarch frontier.

This site documents an ongoing tabletop roleplaying campaign.

## Plain Text Endpoints

For reduced context, plain text versions are available:

- /index.txt - Site overview
- /sessions.txt - Session listing
- /characters.txt - Character listing
- /locations.txt - Location listing
- /npcs.txt - NPC listing
- /factions.txt - Faction listing
- /rumors.txt - Rumor listing
- /items.txt - Item listing
- /creatures.txt - Creature listing
- /storylines.txt - Storyline listing
- /documents.txt - Document listing

Individual pages also have .txt versions (e.g., /sessions/session-1.txt).

## Content Types

Except where otherwise noted, content has been inferred & generated by an LLM.

- **Sessions**: Logs of game sessions with dates, players, and narrative summaries
  Session content is canonical, it was authored by a player in the campaign.
- **Characters**: Player characters with backstories and progression
  Character introductions are canonical, they were authored by a player in the campaign.
- **Locations**: Places discovered and explored in the world
- **NPCs**: Non-player characters encountered
- **Factions**: Organizations and groups operating in the region
- **Rumors**: Quest hooks and leads for future adventures
- **Items**: Notable equipment and artifacts
- **Creatures**: Bestiary of encountered monsters
- **Storylines**: Ongoing plot arcs
- **Documents**: In-world writings (journals, reports, letters)
  Documents are canonical, they were authored by players in the campaign.
- **Artwork**: Character and scene illustrations

This is a fictional campaign setting. All characters, locations, and events are part of a collaborative storytelling game.
